answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: Median first divergence is 1 and edit distance is 0.777, close to the system-prompted range (0 and 0.79–0.82) and far from quantized (10–17, 0.52–0.57). Fine-tuned models diverge at 5.5–8 with edit distance 0.56–0.65, so they fit worse. Style also changed sharply: refusals added 9 (15 vs 6 refusal openings), disclaimers 26.6% vs 7.8%, very short replies 28.1% vs 1.6%, and mean length 52.2 vs 62. This looks like a hidden instruction altering the voice, though 9 added refusals is above the documented 0–1 for system-prompted. That, and no logit or activation data to check the layer-2 spike, leave fine-tuned as a real possibility. Exact-match of 0.016 fits quantized and fine-tuned as well, so it does not decide the case.
